plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Cal-GETC pattern); the alternate Cal-GETC - Fully Online map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 62.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. PSY 190 carries a placement-based prerequisite in its official description (enrollment placement based on high school GPA/other measures, or completion of a pre-statistics or intermediate algebra course) — not modeled as a course prereq since no plan course satisfies it. Other fixed courses on this map list only Advisories in their published descriptions; prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select One' requirements; see choice notes.
